title: Moroccan Sweet Potato Msemen
description: A delicious breakfast dish that combines the flavors of Morocco with the comfort of sweet potatoes. Perfect for a weekend brunch.
instructions: Poke holes in the sweet potatoes and bake for 45-60 minutes, or until tender.
While the sweet potatoes are baking, heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the cumin and coriander and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the msemen to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until crispy.
If using flaky pastry, roll it out and use it to wrap the msemen.
Once the sweet potatoes are done, slice them in half lengthwise and top with the msemen mixture.
Season with salt, black pepper, and chopped parsley.
